html.text: Start A project Contact us Logpom, Douala, Cameroun contact@alivaon.com +237 6 91 96 21 58 Home About Our Services Portfolio Blog FAQ Contact CONTACT US Data & Privacy Your data protected Privacy Policy DATA Alivaon is committed to protecting the privacy of its users. This policy explains how we collect, use and protect your personal data, in accordance with the GDPR and applicable Cameroonian regulations. our commitments to your privacy Secure data SSL encryption, restricted access, ISO 27001-certified hosting. Your data is protected at every level. No resale Your personal data is never sold or rented to third parties for commercial purposes. Full control You can access, amend or delete your data at any time on simple request. GDPR compliance Our practices comply with the European GDPR and Cameroonian data protection law. 1. Data Controller Identity of the data controller The controller of your personal data is: Alivaon - Digital Agency & Software Company Logpom, Douala, Littoral Region, Cameroon Email: contact@alivaon.com Phone: +237 6 91 96 21 58 For any question about your personal data, you can contact us at the address above. We undertake to respond within a maximum of 30 days . 2. Data Collected & Purposes 2.1 Contact form When you use our contact form, we collect the following information: Data collected: First and last name, email address, phone number (optional), your company name (optional), message. Legal basis: Legitimate interest and explicit consent when submitting the form. Purpose: Responding to your request, sending you a quote or information about our services. Retention: 3 years from your last interaction with Alivaon. 2.2 Transactional emails & notifications Following your enquiry, we send you transactional emails (acknowledgement of your request, response to your quote, etc.). These are sent via our email service provider. Data processed: Email address, name, subject of the request. Legal basis: Performance of a contract or pre-contractual measures. You may unsubscribe at any time by writing to us at contact@alivaon.com . 2.3 Newsletter (voluntary subscription) If you subscribe to our newsletter, we collect your email address in order to send you news about our services, blog articles and commercial offers. Legal basis: Explicit consent (double opt-in). Retention: Until you unsubscribe. Unsubscribing: Via the unsubscribe link in every email, or by writing to us directly. 2.4 Browsing data (server logs) Our server automatically collects browsing data for security and performance purposes: IP address (anonymised after 7 days) Browser type and operating system Pages visited and visit duration Connection time and date Legal basis: Legitimate interest (security, fraud detection, performance). This data is not cross-referenced with other personal information. 3. Cookies & Tracking Technologies 3.1 What is a cookie? A cookie is a small text file placed on your device when you visit our site. It stores certain information about your browsing and improves your user experience. You can configure your browser to accept, refuse or delete cookies at any time. Refusing certain cookies may however limit some features of the site. 3.2 Strictly necessary cookies These cookies are essential to the operation of the site. They do not require your consent. Symfony session: Management of your user session (PHPSESSID). Duration: session. CSRF token: Protection against cross-site request forgery attacks when submitting forms. Duration: session. 3.3 Analytics cookies (with your consent) With your consent, we use audience analytics tools to measure traffic and improve our site: Google Analytics: Audience measurement, pages visited, visit duration, visitor origin. The data is anonymised. Duration: 13 months maximum. You can disable Google Analytics via the official extension: tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout . 3.4 Third-party & social media cookies Some pages embed elements from third-party platforms (share buttons, videos). These platforms may place their own cookies on your device: Facebook / Meta LinkedIn Twitter / X YouTube (where videos are embedded) Alivaon has no control over these third-party cookies. We invite you to consult the privacy policies of these platforms. 4. Data Sharing & Transfers 4.1 Service providers and processors Alivaon uses service providers as part of its activities. These processors act solely on Alivaon's instructions and are bound by confidentiality clauses: OVHcloud - Web hosting and data storage Email service provider - Management of transactional emails (contact confirmations, notifications) Google Analytics - Audience analysis (anonymised data) 4.2 International transfers Alivaon works with international clients and partners. In this context, some data may be transferred to countries outside Cameroon. These transfers are governed by: Standard contractual clauses compliant with the GDPR Data processing agreements signed with each provider concerned The safeguards provided by the applicable legislation in the recipient countries 4.3 Legal disclosure Alivaon may be required to disclose your personal data in the event of a legal obligation, a court decision or a request from a competent administrative authority in Cameroon or abroad. Alivaon never sells your personal data to third parties. 5. Data Retention 3 years Contact data (form) From your last interaction with Alivaon. 3 years Prospecting data From the last contact or your deletion request. Until unsubscribed Newsletter Immediate deletion on request. 12 months Server logs & IP Anonymised after 7 days, fully deleted at 12 months. 13 months maximum Analytics cookies In line with CNIL recommendations. 10 years Client contractual data In accordance with legal accounting and tax obligations. 6. Your Rights over your Data 6.1 Right of access You have the right to obtain confirmation as to whether or not data concerning you is being processed by Alivaon, as well as a copy of that data. 6.2 Right to rectification You may request the correction of any inaccurate or incomplete data concerning you in our systems. 6.3 Right to erasure (“right to be forgotten”) You may request the deletion of your personal data, unless its retention is necessary for the performance of a contract, compliance with a legal obligation, or the establishment, exercise or defence of legal claims. 6.4 Right to restriction of processing In certain cases (inaccurate data, unlawful processing, objection to processing), you may request the restriction of the processing of your data - it will be retained but not used. 6.5 Right to data portability You may receive the data concerning you in a structured, commonly used and machine-readable format, and transmit it to another data controller. 6.6 Right to object You may object at any time to the processing of your data for direct marketing purposes. For processing based on legitimate interest, your objection will be upheld unless compelling legitimate grounds prevail. 6.7 How to exercise your rights To exercise your rights, contact us by email at contact@alivaon.com , stating your name, email address and the right you wish to exercise. Proof of identity may be requested to verify your identity. We undertake to respond within 30 days of receiving your request. For complex requests, this period may be extended by a further 2 months, with prior notice. 7. Data Security HTTPS/TLS encryption All communications between your browser and our servers are encrypted via HTTPS with a valid TLS certificate. OWASP application security Our application follows the OWASP Top 10 standards. Protection against SQL injection, XSS, CSRF and other common attacks. Secure hosting Data hosted on OVHcloud infrastructure, certified ISO 27001, HDS and SOC 1/2/3, in European data centres. Restricted access Access to personal data is restricted to Alivaon staff who need it, under confidentiality agreements. 8. Changes to this Policy Changes to the privacy policy Alivaon reserves the right to amend this privacy policy at any time, in particular to comply with any legislative or regulatory change. Amendments take effect as soon as they are published on this page. We encourage you to consult this page regularly. In the event of a substantial change, we will inform you by email if you are subscribed to our newsletter or hold an account on our site.
